targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [V3-EXQ-967, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-967_2026-09-01] V3-EXQ-967 is the cheap confirmer the 2026-08-30 governance note on MECH-143/144 said would run first. It PARTIALLY resolves the mechanism that failure_autopsy_966-436g-951-959-822d-cluster_2026-08-30 left unresolved. ESTABLISHED: the agent_energy route is open. Recomputed from per_step_log (2400 rows, steps 2400-4799), energy_mean is 0.4892 / 0.4845 across arms, energy sits at the 0.0 floor on only 10.2% of steps, and the arms differ by up to 0.99 across 709 steps. The 966 note's third closed route -- agent_energy 'floor-clamped at 0.0 under a 0.01/step decay that dominates' -- is therefore REFUTED; the other two routes (residue sign-gating, agent_health pinned by NUM_HAZARDS=0) are untouched by this run and stand. Note the run's own energy_spends_time_unclamped precondition (0.99) measures distance from the 1.0 CEILING and would read ~1.0 even under a floor clamp, so it is not what refutes the claim; the energy level is. NOT ESTABLISHED: the run's attribution of the surviving contact bit-identity to DV saturation / coarse quantisation. Block-resolved, the logged window covers only the two arm-differing blocks (blocks 0-1 share an amplitude assignment by design, so their matching contacts carry no information). Of those two, block 2 shows ZERO action divergence across 1200 steps -- identical contacts there is a tautology, and read alone resembles the insensitive-policy hypothesis this run is credited with eliminating -- and block 3 shows 46/1200 (3.8%), all after step 4493 in a window ending at 4799, i.e. the arms were action-identical for ~87% of the window. Small integer counts (2 and 6) surviving 46 late divergent steps is at least as consistent with insufficient behavioural exposure as with a coarse DV, and this run cannot separate them. The 'bit-identical on 4/4 blocks' headline overstates the evidence: one block carried discriminative weight. WHAT THIS DOES SUPERSEDE is the 966 autopsy's recommended repair direction -- it routed a retest 'on an env config where the amplitude reaches an unclamped channel', and the amplitude already reaches one; the repair is the DV and the exposure, not the environment. NO CORRECTION TO claims.yaml IS OWED: the note governance applied at the 2026-08-30 PM cycle had already trimmed the three-routes-closed mechanism and said only that the mechanism was unresolved pending this confirmer. Caveat: n=1 seed. PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

learning_extracted: Eliminating one explanation does not establish the named alternative. 967 shows the route is open and the policy is not wholly unresponsive; it does not separate DV quantisation from insufficient behavioural exposure, and its outcome_note asserts the former.

A count of matching cells is not a count of INFORMATIVE cells. 'Bit-identical on 4/4 blocks' covered two blocks sharing an amplitude assignment by design and one in which the arms took identical actions; only one block carried discriminative weight. Report the informative denominator, not the total.

A precondition must be denominated on the quantity the claim it tests is about. energy_spends_time_unclamped measures distance from the 1.0 ceiling and was read against a claim about the 0.0 floor -- it would read ~1.0 under exactly the condition it was invoked to exclude. The floor claim is genuinely refuted, but by energy_mean 0.48 and a 10.2% at-floor fraction, not by that precondition.

A bit-identical DV across arms is a DV property to investigate, not a null result to report. V3-EXQ-966 reported the identity as a finding about the manipulation; the manipulation was live the whole time.

A repair direction inherited from a prior autopsy needs re-checking against the confirmer's own data. 966's 'change the env config' was reasonable on 966's evidence and is wrong on 967's -- naming a downstream repair is not performing it, and the naming does not survive new evidence automatically.

An artifact can be internally inconsistent between its four_layer_diagnosis and its recommended_evidence_quality_note, and it is the NOTE that governance writes into the registry. When re-reading a prior autopsy, check the two against each other rather than reading only the field being superseded.
targets.routing_note: A V3-EXQ-966 successor under a new letter changing the DEPENDENT VARIABLE *and* the exposure -- three changes, not one. (1) Replace the per-block integer contact count with a readout sensitive to when and where divergence occurs (per-step contact indicator series, contact timing, or an energy integral over the block), pre-registered against that statistic. (2) Secure enough behavioural divergence to be worth measuring: 0/1200 and 46/1200 in the two arm-differing blocks is not an exposure a per-block count could have resolved under any quantisation. Log the full run rather than two blocks, and report per-block action divergence alongside the DV so a null is interpretable. (3) Run more than one seed. Keep the env config -- it is adequate.
